steps.do: For each personal party, separately, find every personal checking program that passes all four checks, using the figures in this job's rules. (1) Tenure: the referrer's tenure (compute_tenure) meets the program's minimum. (2) Deposit: the planned new-money deposit meets the program's qualifying deposit, and for Bluest also its $75,000 opening deposit. (3) Age: the referred person's age fits: Light Green 13-24, Dark Green 17-26, Gold Years 62 or older, all others 18 or older. (4) Cap: the program is not full (caps_from_records_personal). The account types the referrer holds do not matter. Rank the passing programs by the customer's ranking_goal: combined bonus (referrer plus referred) or the referrer's own bonus. Recommend the top program and state both bonus amounts. If a program that would otherwise rank higher was dropped (for example by its annual cap), tell the customer which one and why.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged, or told they could not be verified. Their referral history (the 9-day window and per-type annual counts, not counting REJECTED or ERROR) and their account tenure have been checked from the records, and any of their own figures that differ from the records have been corrected. Then one of three outcomes holds. (a) The customer was told the referral cannot be submitted now and why: rolling window full, tenure too short, same registered address, referred party not new or same business owner, signer under 18, or no program's deposit, cap or age rule met. No recommendation was given and nothing was submitted. (b) The customer was told the eligible account to use, ranked by their stated goal (combined bonus or their own bonus), with both bonus amounts, the qualifying deposit and its window, and the conditions. An active business promotion was used only to order programs the customer's requirements leave tied. They have submitted submit_referral with that account type (or know to do so), and the result has been explained. (c) For several parties: each party has a recommended account or a reason it has none. A party whose every option is blocked (for example by annual caps) was told why and was not submitted. The customer was told about the 2-per-9-day limit and chose which referrals go first (for example one personal and one business, each the best of its category by their goal). They submitted no more than the open slots. For each party still waiting, they know the account to use and when a slot opens.
